items.text: Edward Jones states that financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.
items.quote: Financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.

items.text: Edward Jones states that financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors.
items.quote: Financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership’s profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that the Program Fee, assets under care, and client Reserve Line Advance balances impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and the bonus amount, and may impact eligibility for certain limited partnership profits interest.
items.quote: The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and Reserve Line Advance balances, will impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and bonus amount. The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and client Reserve Line Advance balances may also impact a financial advisors' eligibility for the receipt of certain limited partnership profits interest in The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P. (the "Profits Interest").

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that most financial advisors are eligible for a Travel Award Program (travel or a cash award in lieu), with eligibility based on the amount of new and existing assets under care of a financial advisor.
items.quote: Most financial advisors are eligible to participate in the Edward Jones Travel Award Program ("Travel Award Program"), which includes domestic and international travel, or a cash award in lieu of a trip. Eligibility for the Travel Award Program is based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care of a financial advisor which creates an additional conflict of interest.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that a financial advisor will typically earn more in upfront fees and commissions on brokerage services, but will typically earn more over time on Advisory Solutions Fund Models accounts.
items.quote: A financial advisor will typically earn more in upfront fees and commissions when you use brokerage services. In the alternative, a financial advisor will typically earn more over time if you invest in Advisory Solutions Fund Models.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that a financial advisor may receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of the financial advisor's branch.
items.quote: In addition, your financial advisor may also receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of your financial advisor's branch.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that eligible retiring financial advisors are offered individually tailored retirement transition plans compensating them for providing client transition services, generally paid ratably over four years.
items.quote: Eligible retiring financial advisors are offered individually tailored retirement transition plans. Each retirement transition plan compensates a retiring financial advisor for successfully providing client transition services in accordance with a retirement and transition agreement.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that it maintains a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.
items.quote: The Partnership has a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.

items.text: Edward Jones states that a significant portion of its more successful financial advisors' compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability.
items.quote: there is increased risk the Partnership’s more successful financial advisors may leave because a significant portion of their compensation is variable based on the Partnership’s profitability.

items.text: Edward Jones states that periods with lower Firm profitability and revenue result in decreases in variable and commission-based compensation.
items.quote: periods with lower Firm profitability and revenue result in decreases in variable and commission-based compensation
